## Step: Reconcile log contents

Stage: READY for local recheck or repair of the existing operation.

Use `reconcile_log(log: &mut Vec<Entry>, previous: usize, incoming: Vec<Entry>)`
in `crates/raft-verified/src/reconcile.rs`. Reject invalid predecessor/checked
length overflow without changing the log. Compare overlapping terms; at the first
conflict or missing position replace the remaining suffix. Empty, fully matching
or shorter matching requests preserve the existing tail. Same-term/different-payload
entries retain the old entry under `merged`; changing comparison semantics needs
review. Protocol positions use zero as the prefix sentinel; stored entries use
zero-based offsets. The future caller checks u64-to-usize conversion, message and
predecessor terms, committed-prefix compatibility and durability ordering.

Edit only the shared executable source. Preserve the protected view, proof caller
and regression oracles. Rust tests, replay, benchmarks and Verus must use this same
operation. Vec allocation may abort; no recoverable-OOM or resource-liveness claim
is made. Read the slice tests and `crates/raft-verified/check.py` before editing.

Run `python3 -m orchestrator verify --profile interface-check`, then profiles
`reconcile-tests`, `reconcile-replay`, `reconcile-proof` and `reconcile-bench`.
Finish only when all required checks succeed for their respective purposes on
unchanged code. Missing tools or checks block completion; failed semantics or
protected-target changes require review, not weakened expectations.

# Log replication

Status: DRAFT. Module: INCOMPLETE. Only log-suffix reconciliation and its local
proof/tests/replay are implemented; follower and leader protocol paths are absent.

## Responsibility and connections

Implement the full replication exchange over successive requests: leader proposal
append and persistence, per-peer AppendEntries generation, heartbeat/retry service,
follower term/predecessor validation, log reconciliation, durable replies and
leader response processing/backtracking. Maintain current-term peer progress and
supply validated durable match positions to [commitment](commitment.md).

[Elections](elections.md) establishes roles; [state](state.md) stores logs/progress;
[runtime](runtime.md) orders writes and messages. Use existing MessageBody variants
and the model's `propose`, `send_append`, `merged`, `receive_append`,
`receive_append_response`, `higher_term`, `storage_ack` and `flush_message`.
Read [model.md](model.md), [io.md](io.md) and the executable library first. Multi-entry
AppendEntries is required; snapshots and performance pipelining remain excluded.

## Module completion

Both sides of replication run through the node dispatcher and handle stale terms,
failed predecessor checks, duplicates, reordered responses and retries. Tests cover
empty heartbeats, matching tails, conflicts, missing suffixes, committed-prefix
protection, durable response timing and leader changes. Cluster fault scenarios
use these actual handlers. Prove local correspondence and supporting log/term
invariants feeding S-APPEND, S-LOG and S-COMPLETE; global composition remains required.
`LOCAL-RECONCILE` proves only the helper's relation to `merged`. Passing the ready
steps below leaves this module incomplete while protocol paths are missing.
